## Import Spacious Demo

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/import-spacious-demo/>

Once the theme is installed and activated, you can import the demos. Demos are the pre-built pages with all the customization control. Importing the demo will add all the content on your end, where you can replace the demo content with your text and images.

The Spacious theme comes with 35+ demos, of which few are available with the free version, and others are available with the Pro and Pro Plus Spacious plan. As you can check on the Spacious demo page , the one having no labels is available with the free plan, the one with the PRO is available with the Spacious Pro Plan, and the label with the **PRO PLUS** label is available with the** Spacious Pro Plus plan**.

## Import Free Demos

After successfully installing and activating the Spacious theme on your site, you can import the demo. If you do not want to import the demo, you can skip the part and start building your site on your own. However, to import the demo, you can follow the steps below:

- Click on the **Get Started with Spacious button,** which appears after activating the Spacious theme. It activates the **ThemeGrill Demo Importer Plugin**.

- On the demo list page, select the appropriate demo that best suits your site.

- Hover over the demo and click on **Import** to import the demo to your website.

Importing the demo will take a few minutes. Once the demo is imported successfully, you are ready to edit and design the site. You can follow the guideline for editing the imported demo.

## Import Spacious Pro Demos

As mentioned above, to import the Spacious Pro demos, you’ll; need to purchase the Spacious Pro and the above plan from here: Spacious Pricing . Once purchased, installed, and activated, you can follow the steps “Import Free Demos’ explained above.

## Import Spacious Pro Plus Demos

Importing the Spacious Pro Plus demos is somewhat similar as importing other demos. However, they require a special plugin to import. The plugin “Companion Addons for Elementor” lets you import the Spacious pro plus demos, such as Spacious Pro Counseling, Spacious Pro Health Information, etc., as listed on the Spacious demos page .

These demos require Companion addons for the Elementor plugin that is available with the Spacious Pro Plus and All Theme plan. Once the plugin is installed and activated on your end, you can follow the steps above to import the Pro Plus demos.

## Upgrading from Spacious to Spacious Pro

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/upgrading-from-spacious-to-spacious-pro/>

If you are currently a free user and would like to upgrade to the Pro version from a free theme, then it’s quite easy. And the good news is **All your content theme settings will remain as it is even after switching to the Pro theme**. You don’t need to redo what you have built with the free version.

You can follow the steps below for upgrading the Spacious to Spacious Pro:

### Purchase and Download

- Purchase the Spacious Theme

- Login to your ThemeGrill Account

- Go to **Downloads**

- Download the **Spacious Pro Theme,** and you will get the ** s pacious-pro-latest.zip** file

### Install and Activate

- Navigate to **WordPress Dashboard **> **Appearance** > **Themes**

- Click on **Add New**

- Click on **Upload Theme** > **Choose File**

- Choose the **Spacious Pro** theme zip file from your local computer

- Click on **Install Now** to start installing

- Click on the** Activate** button to make the theme work on your site

### Activate License

- Go to your ThemeGrill Account

- Go to **License** s and click on **Spacious** from the list

- Copy the License Key by clicking on the Copy link

- From WordPress Dashboard, go to **Settings > Spacious Pro License Manager**

- Paste the license key there to get automatic updates and support

## Install Spacious Theme

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/install-spacious-theme/>

Getting started with the Spacious theme is quite easy and quick. You can follow the methods below for installing the Spacious theme and importing the demo.

### Via Spacious Page

- Go to ThemeGrill Spacious Page

- Click on **Download Now** button, which will redirect to the pricing page

- Upon scrolling the page, click the **Download Free Version** button to download the Spacious zip file

- Navigate to **WordPress Dashboard **> **Appearance** > **Themes** and click on **Add New**

- Click on **Upload Theme** > **Choose File**

- Choose the Spacious theme zip file from your local computer

- Click on **Install Now** to start installing

- Click on the** Activate** button to make the theme work on your site

### Via WordPress Dashboard

- From your WordPress Dashboard, navigate to **Appearance > Themes **and click on **Add New**

- Search for – **Spacious**

- Click on **Install** to run the installation

- Click on the** Activate** button to make the theme work on your site

### Import Demos

After installing the Spacious theme successfully on your site, you can import the demo. If you do not want to import the demo, you can skip the part and start building your site. However, for importing the demo, you can follow the steps below:

- Click on **Get Started with Spacious button,** which appears after activating the Spacious theme. It activates the **ThemeGrill Demo Importer Plugin**.

- On the demo list page, select the appropriate demo that best suits your site.

- Hover over the demo and click on **Import** to import the demo to your website.

Importing the demo will take a few minutes. Once the demo is imported successfully, you can edit and design the site. You can follow the guideline for editing the imported demo How to Edit Imported Demo Site ?
